title: I Believe In Miracles
original_lyrics:

I used to be on an endless run

[bridge]
I have been blessed with the power to survive
After all these years I'm still alive
I'm out here cookin' with the band
I no longer solitary man
Every day my time runs out
Lived like fool, that's what I was about, oh
I believe in miracles
I believe in better world for me and you
Oh, I believe in miracles
I believe in better world for me and you
Tattoo your name on my arm
I always said my girl's my good luck charm
If she could find reason to forgive
Then I could find reason to live
I used to be on an endless run

I have been blessed with the power to survive
After all these years I'm still alive

I believe in better world for me and you
Oh, I believe in miracles

The future's here today, it's not too late,
it's not too late, yeah!
